mdReplaceExact.find: Geography helps us understand how people interact with their environment and how natural and human resources shape development. This Form 4 Learner’s Book builds on your earlier studies by focusing on Zambia’s key economic and environmental sectors. The topics - beginning with Zambia and moving through Forestry, Agriculture, Fishing, Tourism, Mining, Fuel and Energy, Manufacturing and Processing Industries, and Transport and Communication - show how Zambia’s economy and environment are connected. This book encourages you to explore how people use resources, how industries grow, and how development can be made sustainable. It promotes inquiry, observation, and critical thinking through activities, maps, and case studies drawn from real Zambian examples. By studying these topics, you will learn how Geography explains everyday life - from farming and tourism to mining and transport - and how each sector contributes to national progress. Teachers and learners are encouraged to use this book as a guide for discussion, research, and practical learning that connects classroom knowledge to real‑world experiences. Through this study, you will gain not only knowledge but also appreciation for Zambia’s rich environment and the role you can play in its sustainable development.
